_comment: Copy this to `ecosine-profile.json` and fill it in with your own details. The server re-reads that file on every request, so an edit takes effect without a restart. `ecosine-profile.json` is git-ignored and must stay that way — it is where your name, contact details and employer live. The assistant runs fine without it; it just will not know who you are.

identity.name: Your Name
identity.professional_identity: A sentence or two on what you do and the disciplines you combine.
identity.positioning: How you want to be described in written work — the angle, not the CV.

employer.name: Your Employer Ltd.
employer.relationship: Your relationship to it — employee, owner, consultant.
employer.note: Anything that stops the assistant misreading the corporate structure — e.g. which entities are subsidiaries rather than businesses you own.

career.current: Current role, employer, location and dates.
career.previous: What you did before, and the areas it covered.

team.note: The people you work with directly. The assistant refers to them the way you do.

demonstrated_outcomes: Measurable results you want cited in written work. Numbers travel further than adjectives.

leadership_pillars.pillar_one: A theme you lead on, and how.

core_expertise: Statutes, systems and disciplines you work in daily
signature_work: A project worth naming — what it was and what changed because of it.

problem_solving_method.name: Name your method, if you have one
problem_solving_method.steps: How you work a problem, stage by stage.
problem_solving_method.guiding_principle: The question you ask that others do not.

group_entities_seen_in_his_files.note: Entities that turn up in documents on your machine, so the assistant reads them correctly rather than guessing.
recurring_document_types: The kinds of document that come up often — licences, payroll files, contracts
Note the languages, so OCR and search are pointed the right way

how_to_work_with_him.spoken_replies: Tone for spoken answers — replies are read aloud, so length and register matter.
how_to_work_with_him.written_deliverables: Tone for CVs, proposals, strategy documents and bios.
how_to_work_with_him.hard_rule: Never invent employers, qualifications, clients, credentials, projects or metrics beyond this profile. If something is not here, say so rather than filling the gap.

current_project: What you are building right now.

assistant.name: AHMED
assistant.note: The assistant's own name and how it should refer to itself.
